Install Local AI on Windows in 3 Minutes with Ollama | Zero Cloud Cost Setup

In this opening hands-on lesson of the Codealytica AI/ML training series, instructor Gopinath introduces the fundamentals of local artificial intelligence. We bypass theoretical slide decks and jump straight into setting up Ollama on Windows using both the official installer and automated PowerShell commands. Discover why running open-source large language models locally eliminates cloud API costs, guarantees complete data privacy, and delivers instant offline inference.

lessons.title: Google Gemma 2B Architecture & Parameters Explained | Local LLM Deep Dive
lessons.description:
Google Gemma 2B Architecture & Parameters Explained | Local LLM Deep Dive

In this technical deep-dive, instructor Gopinath demystifies large language model parameter counts, open weights, and local execution. We verify the Ollama CLI daemon, deconstruct the 'ollama run gemma:2b' command, and explain Google's Gemma architecture. Learn what 'E2B' (Effective 2 Billion) parameters signify in memory and compute, explore practical quantization, and master the foundational Music Player Analogy ('Ollama is the music player, Gemma is the song').

Instructor: Gopinath
Brand: Codealytica | CODE. ANALYZE. BUILD. GROW.
Series: Generative AI & LLM Engineering Masterclass (Day 01)

lessons.title: Local AI Benchmark & Windows Task Manager GPU Monitoring | Live LLM Test
lessons.description:
Local AI Benchmark & Windows Task Manager GPU Monitoring | Live LLM Test

In this hands-on engineering demonstration, instructor Gopinath executes identical prompts simultaneously across Qwen 0.5B and Gemma 2B. We open Windows Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc) during active inference to inspect real-time hardware telemetry. Discover why local LLMs utilize 35%+ of the dedicated NVIDIA GPU while integrated Intel graphics and general CPU remain untouched, and learn how to optimize local inference on everyday laptops.

lessons.title: Generative AI vs Traditional AI Explained + 3 Golden Rules | Day 01 Finale
lessons.description:
Generative AI vs Traditional AI Explained + 3 Golden Rules | Day 01 Finale

In this inspiring Day 01 finale, instructor Gopinath grounds our practical local experiments in core computer science theory. Using the 5-role thought experiment (poem, poster, song, Python code, executive presentation), we deconstruct the architectural distinction between Traditional Predictive AI (spam classification, churn) and Generative AI synthesis. Gopinath delivers his 3 Golden Rules of Applied AI, democratizes AI learning ('Start with what you have'), and delivers his official concluding remarks.

Instructor: Gopinath
Brand: Codealytica | CODE. ANALYZE. BUILD. GROW.
Series: Generative AI & LLM Engineering Masterclass (Day 01)
